_comment: Genie's MCP set, loaded with --mcp-config + --strict-mcp-config so it REPLACES the
root .mcp.json rather than merging with it. Two reasons this is scoped rather than
1. GRAPHITI_GROUP_ID is a LITERAL 'jarvis-core' in the root .mcp.json, and an env
value set there overrides the parent process env. Genie exporting
GRAPHITI_GROUP_ID=genie-core would therefore have had NO effect, and every
entity Genie learned would have been filed into Jarvis's graph. Setting it here
is the only place that actually binds.
2. Genie has no use for annas-archive, so it is deliberately absent — a smaller
tool surface and one less place the tracked ANNAS_SECRET_KEY has to travel.
SUPERSEDED 2026-08-14: Genie requested it for the GENESIS literature work, and
the secret objection is answered — scripts/annas_mcp_launch.sh reads the key at
launch from files ALREADY outside the WVU tree, so nothing enters that repo.
Root .mcp.json is left untouched: W0 and W11 depend on it and neither needed to change.
annas-archive + arxiv were added here, NOT to WVU/.mcp.json, because this lane launches
with --strict-mcp-config: ONLY this file is read. A project .mcp.json is ignored just as
silently as the earlier settings.json attempt was — same class of failure, one layer out.
This file is the ONLY config that binds for W12.
